headline: Executive order signed in February 2026 directs federal action related to coal-fired power plants, framed around national defense.
what_it_does: This executive order addresses the nation's coal-fired power plants and ties them to national defense. Based on its title, it appears to direct federal agencies to support or preserve coal power generation. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies involved, and requirements are not known from the available information.

They may be directed to take actions involving coal power, but the details are not stated in the title.
